plugin.name: GoPress MCP
plugin.description: Securely expose GoPress Agent capabilities through the official MCP protocol, read-only by default.
plugin.settings.title: %s - Plugin Settings
plugin.mcp.subtitle: Manage the MCP endpoint, Tool policy, short-lived credentials, and call audit.
plugin.mcp.tabs.label: MCP settings
plugin.mcp.overview.title: MCP Safe Write Beta
plugin.mcp.overview.help: The endpoint exists only while this plugin is active. Every Tool call remains subject to scopes, RBAC, and audit.
plugin.mcp.connection.title: Client connection
plugin.mcp.connection.help: Issue a Token under Credentials, then replace the placeholder below. The outer configuration shape may differ between clients.
plugin.mcp.protocol.title: Protocol and security
plugin.mcp.diagnostics.initial: Run diagnostics to check the current endpoint state.
plugin.mcp.diagnostics.ready: Ready: endpoint, authentication, and Agent Registry are available.
plugin.mcp.diagnostics.http_warning: Ready, but non-local endpoints should use HTTPS.
plugin.mcp.policy.title: Tool Profile and write controls
plugin.mcp.policy.help: The default Profile is read-only. Safe Write still requires each Tool and its credential scope to be enabled; RBAC, ownership, optimistic locking, confirmation, and idempotency remain mandatory.
plugin.mcp.policy.read_only_help: Write Tools are hidden from discovery and direct calls are denied by Core.
plugin.mcp.policy.safe_write_help: Only the content and media Tools explicitly selected below are enabled.
plugin.mcp.policy.warning: Publish and trash are never enabled automatically with Safe Write. Both need their own switch; publish also requires content.publish, and dangerous calls require confirm=true.
plugin.mcp.credentials.title: Issue an access credential
plugin.mcp.credentials.help: The Token is shown once and bound to this administrator, MCP endpoint, and expiry. Grant only the scopes the Agent needs.
plugin.mcp.credentials.name: Credential name
plugin.mcp.credentials.revoke_confirm: Revoke this Token now? Connected clients will immediately lose access.
plugin.mcp.scope.site: Read basic site information and capability summary
plugin.mcp.scope.content: Read content types, content lists, and content details
plugin.mcp.scope.taxonomy: Read taxonomies attached to content types
plugin.mcp.scope.content_write: Create drafts, update, trash, or restore content as enabled by the Tool policy
plugin.mcp.scope.content_publish: Publish content; the role must also hold the separate content.publish capability
plugin.mcp.scope.media_write: Update media alt text, title, and caption
plugin.mcp.token.title: Save this Token now
plugin.mcp.token.help: It cannot be shown again after closing or reloading this page. Revoke and reissue it if lost.
plugin.mcp.audit.title: Agent call audit
plugin.mcp.audit.help: Stores argument size, digest, and top-level field names only. Argument values and Bearer Tokens are never stored.
plugin.mcp.audit.initial: Open this tab to load audit data.
plugin.mcp.column.name: Name
plugin.mcp.copy.unsupported: Automatic copy is unavailable in this browser. Copy the text manually.
plugin.mcp.copy.failed: Copy failed. Copy the text manually.
